options.why: The selected acyclic edges can be extended to some minimum spanning tree; a cut exchange preserves that existence.
A cheap edge can have tied alternatives, so it need not belong to every optimum.
DSU roots depend on merging history; the minimum-ID rule is not part of correctness.
Minimum spanning tree cost and source-to-vertex shortest paths are different objectives.

items.explanation: Exchange preserves some optimum containing choices.
